subject.title: improve(ui): move Sessions from the sidebar More menu into Settings

question: Should this UI change intentionally remove existing persisted `sessions` sidebar pins during upgrade while preserving only URL compatibility?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but repository policy treats persisted user preferences as compatibility-sensitive and the correct product tradeoff cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve the pin reset
options.body: Accept that Sessions is no longer pin-capable, retain the `/sessions` alias, and merge after refreshing against current main.

options.title: Preserve customization
options.body: Revise the design to retain a supported Sessions sidebar affordance or provide an explicit transition for existing pinned users.

recommendation.title: Approve the pin reset
recommendation.body: Accept that Sessions is no longer pin-capable, retain the `/sessions` alias, and merge after refreshing against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the adjacent sidebar and Settings-entry design, making them the strongest available routing candidate for this UX tradeoff.
